company.name: Fugue
company.shortDescription: Fugue ensures cloud infrastructure stays in continuous compliance with enterprise security policies.
company.description:
Fugue ensures cloud infrastructure stays in continuous compliance with enterprise security policies. Its solution identifies cloud infrastructure security risks and compliance violations and ensures that they are never repeated. Fugue provides baseline drift detection and automated remediation to eliminate data breaches, and powerful visualization and reporting tools to easily demonstrate compliance.

Fugue automates compliance audits with out-of-the-box frameworks for HIPAA, GDPR, CIS Benchmark, and NIST 800-53, and supports custom policies. Fugue works with CI/CD pipelines to ensure compliance and prevent unauthorized change. Customers like Sparkpost, PBS, and SAP NS2 rely on Fugue to protect against cloud risks and enforce compliance.
